LanguageData.LP_Leather_Displacer.label: displacer beast hide
LanguageData.LP_Leather_Displacer.description: Displacer beast fur, deep purple nearly black, seeming slightly offset in the light. Warmer and prettier than panther hide, and a bit harder to pierce.
LanguageData.LP_EggOwlbearFertilized.label: owlbear egg
LanguageData.LP_EggOwlbearFertilized.description: A fertilized owlbear egg. Hatches into an owlbear cub after about 12 days; the cub belongs to the egg's owner. Can be eaten raw, but cooking is better.
LanguageData.LP_EggOwlbearUnfertilized.label: owlbear egg (unfertilized)
LanguageData.LP_EggOwlbearUnfertilized.description: An owlbear egg that will not hatch. Can be eaten raw, but cooking is better.
LanguageData.LP_Owlbear.label: owlbear
LanguageData.LP_Owlbear.description: A bear's body with the head and beak of an owl, said to be the creation of a mad wizard. Bad-tempered; when it lands on prey it often hugs it tight with both arms so it can't move. Lays eggs like a bird: a female owlbear lays one egg about 15 days after fertilization.\n\nElves get along with woodland creatures; elves have double the chance to tame one.
LanguageData.LP_Worg.label: worg
LanguageData.LP_Worg.description: A huge, malicious and cunning wolf that often travels in packs and is said to raid alongside orcs. When several worgs gather they howl back and forth and coordinate their bites: +5% melee hit chance for each companion within 8 cells, up to +20%.\n\nHalf-orcs understand worg ways; half-orcs have double the chance to tame one.
LanguageData.LP_WinterWolf.label: winter wolf
LanguageData.LP_WinterWolf.description: A giant wolf with ice-blue fur whose very breath carries frost. Its bite deals extra frostbite and leaves the target frost slowed (move speed halved for 4 seconds). Extremely cold-hardy but afraid of fire: takes ×150% fire damage. Butchering yields winter wolf pelt.
LanguageData.LP_HellHound.label: hell hound
LanguageData.LP_HellHound.description: A hound from the lower planes with dark red, nearly black fur and a faint glow of fire all over. Its bite carries flame, and hitting a troll blocks its regeneration. Completely unafraid of fire and cannot be ignited; withstands extreme heat.\n\nFire giants have kept hell hounds for ages; fire giants have double the chance to tame one.
LanguageData.LP_DisplacerBeast.label: displacer beast
LanguageData.LP_DisplacerBeast.description: A large deep purple-blue cat with a pair of bone-spiked tentacles on its shoulders. Its image is always offset from where it really is: it always has a "displacement phantom", so the next attack that would deal damage (melee, ranged or explosion) hits the phantom and misses completely, then the phantom vanishes for 6 seconds before returning. No longer works once downed.\n\nDisplacer beast hide is warmer and prettier than panther hide.
LanguageData.LP_BlinkDog.label: blink dog
LanguageData.LP_BlinkDog.description: A pale golden, clever and friendly canine that can teleport short distances. Never attacks people on its own and fights back when attacked; after being hit there is a 30% chance it blinks 3-6 cells away from the attacker (cooldown 10 seconds).\n\nElves and blink dogs have been friends since ancient times; elves have double the chance to tame one.
